stretches.name: Overhead side bend
stretches.cue: Feet hip-width, both arms overhead. Hold your wrist and lean to one side, keeping the hips still.

stretches.name: Neck side release
stretches.cue: Drop one ear toward the shoulder and rest that hand lightly on your head. Keep the other shoulder down.

stretches.name: Cross-body shoulder
stretches.cue: Draw one arm straight across your chest. Hook your other forearm under the elbow and pull gently.

stretches.name: Chest opener
stretches.cue: Clasp your hands behind your back, straighten the arms and lift the chest. Keep the ribs from flaring.

stretches.name: Overhead triceps
stretches.cue: Take one arm overhead and let the hand drop behind your head. The other hand presses the elbow back.

stretches.name: Side lunge
stretches.cue: Feet wide, toes forward. Bend one knee and sit back into it while the other leg stays long.

stretches.name: Standing hip flexor
stretches.cue: Split stance, back heel lifted. Tuck the pelvis under and press the back hip forward.

stretches.name: Standing quad
stretches.cue: Stand tall on one leg and draw the other ankle up behind you. Knees close, hips level.

stretches.name: Calf press
stretches.cue: Hands on a wall. Step one foot back, keep that leg straight and press the heel down.

stretches.name: Standing figure-four
stretches.cue: Cross one ankle over the opposite thigh and sit back into an invisible chair. Hinge forward slightly.

stretches.name: Standing twist
stretches.cue: Arms out wide. Rotate the ribcage to one side and let the arms swing with it, then the other.

stretches.name: Sunrise reach
stretches.cue: Reach tall through the fingertips and rise onto the balls of your feet, then lower slowly.
